description:
About the company
 Our client is an advanced manufacturing technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Join an early engineering group as a hands-on builder, designing and shipping internal software systems from scratch and owning them end-to-end. You will work closely with the people who use the software every day, gathering feedback and iterating quickly. The work focuses on operational software for a physical production environment, built so it can be reused across multiple sites.
 What you'll do
 - Build an enterprise resource planning system covering inventory, material tracking and workflow across a facility.
 - Develop monitoring software that exchanges low-latency data with industrial equipment.
 - Create quality management tools that track and improve precision part quality.
 - Work directly with floor operators to collect feedback and iterate quickly on the tools they use daily.
 - Architect systems so they can be replicated across multiple sites.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 2+ years of software engineering experience.
 - Track record of building and shipping real products at high-intensity technology companies or startups.
 - Computer science degree from a top-30 program.
 - Academic record of a 3.75+ GPA, or 4.0 GPA if from a program outside the top 30.
 - Strong Python proficiency.
 - Strong machine learning knowledge, including model fine-tuning.
 - High agency: able to take ambiguous problems and deliver solutions independently.
 - Able to work on-site full-time.
 - U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident, eligible under export-control requirements.
 Bonus points
 - Background in industrial or hardware-adjacent business software.
 - Past work on products where you learned directly from the people using them.
 - Familiarity with geometry-heavy, design-to-production or robotics programming.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 130,000 to 200,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - Austin, TX, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
